'''''Hyacinthoides mauritanica''''' (common name: '''Mauritius bluebell''') is a flowering plant endemic to [[Morocco]] and [[Portugal]]. It is a bulbous [[Storage organ|geophyte]] that grows primarily in temperate regions.<ref name=POWO>{{Cite taxon | powo |title=''Hyacinthoides mauritanica'' (Schousb.) Speta |id=943896-1 |access-date=2024-07-05}}</ref>

== Description ==
''Hyacinthoides mauritanica'' is a species of dwarf bluebell, growing up to {{cvt|10|cm}} in height.<ref>{{Cite web |title=''Hyacinthoides mauritanica'' – RarePlants |url=https://www.rareplants.co.uk/product/hyacinthoides-mauritanica/ |access-date=2024-07-06 |website=www.rareplants.co.uk}}</ref> It is a bulbous [[perennial]], with long, narrow leaves and bell or star-shaped blue, violet or white flowers in spring.<ref>{{Cite web |title=''Hyacinthoides mauritanica'' {{!}} Mauritius bluebell /RHS Gardening |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/236049/hyacinthoides-mauritanica/details |access-date=2024-07-05 |website=www.rhs.org.uk |language=en-gb}}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
It grows in open land, close to sea-level, in damp and often sandy soil.<ref name="flahaultiana">{{Cite web |title=''Hyacinthoides flahaultiana'' – RarePlants |url=https://www.rareplants.co.uk/product/hyacinthoides-flahaultiana|access-date=2024-07-06 |website=www.rareplants.co.uk}}</ref>

When ''Hyacinthoides'' (or "''Scilla''") were found in Morocco in the past they were frequently mis-identified as ''mauritanica''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hyacinthoides {{!}} Pacific Bulb Society |url=https://www.pacificbulbsociety.org/pbswiki/index.php/Hyacinthoides |access-date=2024-07-05 |website=www.pacificbulbsociety.org}}</ref> However these are two distinct species, although they may still both be encountered under either name.<ref name="flahaultiana" />
